{{Top|leg}}
'''Croww''' was an independent [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who made a living buying and selling [[R5-series astromech droid]]s during the height of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Croww shared advice on buying the droids in bulk and selling them in the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]] and [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]] on "[[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]]."
